ruleDefinitions.name: Suspicious File Download From File Sharing Websites -  File Stream
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects the download of suspicious file type from a well-known file and paste sharing domain Note: Unmapped fields: Contents

sequences.query: ((Contents = RGX(".*\\\.githubusercontent\\\.com.*") OR Contents = RGX(".*anonfiles\\\.com.*") OR Contents = RGX(".*cdn\\\.discordapp\\\.com.*") OR Contents = RGX(".*ddns\\\.net.*") OR Contents = RGX(".*dl\\\.dropboxusercontent\\\.com.*") OR Contents = RGX(".*ghostbin\\\.co.*") OR Contents = RGX(".*glitch\\\.me.*") OR Contents = RGX(".*gofile\\\.io.*") OR Contents = RGX(".*hastebin\\\.com.*") OR Contents = RGX(".*mediafire\\\.com.*") OR Contents = RGX(".*mega\\\.nz.*") OR Contents = RGX(".*onrender\\\.com.*") OR Contents = RGX(".*pages\\\.dev.*") OR Contents = RGX(".*paste\\\.ee.*") OR Contents = RGX(".*pastebin\\\.com.*") OR Contents = RGX(".*pastebin\\\.pl.*") OR Contents = RGX(".*pastetext\\\.net.*") OR Contents = RGX(".*pixeldrain\\\.com.*") OR Contents = RGX(".*privatlab\\\.com.*") OR Contents = RGX(".*privatlab\\\.net.*") OR Contents = RGX(".*send\\\.exploit\\\.in.*") OR Contents = RGX(".*sendspace\\\.com.*") OR Contents = RGX(".*storage\\\.googleapis\\\.com.*") OR Contents = RGX(".*storjshare\\\.io.*") OR Contents = RGX(".*supabase\\\.co.*") OR Contents = RGX(".*temp\\\.sh.*") OR Contents = RGX(".*transfer\\\.sh.*") OR Contents = RGX(".*trycloudflare\\\.com.*") OR Contents = RGX(".*ufile\\\.io.*") OR Contents = RGX(".*w3spaces\\\.com.*") OR Contents = RGX(".*workers\\\.dev.*")) AND (file_path = RGX(".*\\\.cpl\\:Zone.*") OR file_path = RGX(".*\\\.dll\\:Zone.*") OR file_path = RGX(".*\\\.exe\\:Zone.*") OR file_path = RGX(".*\\\.hta\\:Zone.*") OR file_path = RGX(".*\\\.lnk\\:Zone.*") OR file_path = RGX(".*\\\.one\\:Zone.*") OR file_path = RGX(".*\\\.vbe\\:Zone.*") OR file_path = RGX(".*\\\.vbs\\:Zone.*") OR file_path = RGX(".*\\\.xll\\:Zone.*")))
